The test image shows a corn plant with:
- **Reddish/purple-pink discoloration** on upper leaves and stalk
- **Lower leaves dead/dried** (brown, necrotic)
- **Top dieback** pattern — upper plant affected with reddish streaking
- Stunted appearance with dying lower canopy

This pattern strongly suggests Anthracnose top dieback. Let me confirm with the reference image.

The reference for Anthracnose_leaf_spot_top_dieback shows close-up leaf spots with brown/dark lesions and yellow halos. The test image shows a different presentation — whole-plant top dieback with **purple-red discoloration on the upper stalk and leaves**, which is the top dieback phase of anthracnose (caused by *Colletotrichum graminicola*). This is a classic field presentation of anthracnose top dieback:

- Purple/reddish coloration on upper stalk and leaf sheaths
- Leaves dying from top downward
- Lower leaves necrotic/dried out
- Plant appears stunted

The class name "Anthracnose_leaf_spot_top_dieback" covers both the leaf spot and top dieback manifestations of this disease. The whole-plant reddish-purple top dieback pattern matches this class.
